mapper.sql:
left join proj_contract c on c.id = p.contract_id and c.del_flag = '0'
left join proj_project rp on rp.id = p.related_project_id and rp.del_flag = '0'
left join proj_report_submit_log sl on sl.project_code = p.project_code and sl.del_flag = '0' left join proj_report_submit_log sl2 on sl2.project_code = rp.project_code and sl2.del_flag = '0' left join ( select project_id,
sum(case when payment_type = 'refund' then -coalesce(amount, 0) else coalesce(amount, 0) end) filter (where ) as total_received, sum(case when payment_type = 'refund' then coalesce(amount, 0) else 0 end) filter (where ) as refund_amount, max(pay_time) filter (where ) as max_pay_time, sum(coalesce(invoice_amount, 0)) as total_invoice,
max(case when payment_type = 'final' then pay_time end) filter (where ) as final_pay_time, max(case when payment_type = 'advance' then pay_time end) filter (where ) as advance_pay_time,
sum(case when payment_type = 'advance' then coalesce(amount, 0) else 0 end) filter (where ) as advance_amount, sum(case when payment_type = 'final' then coalesce(amount, 0) else 0 end) filter (where ) as final_amount,
string_agg(distinct nullif(btrim(coalesce(remark, '')), ''), '；') filter (where ) as pay_remark,
string_agg(distinct coalesce(nullif(btrim(plan_report_month), ''), to_char(pay_time, 'YYYY-MM')), '、' order by coalesce(nullif(btrim(plan_report_month), ''), to_char(pay_time, 'YYYY-MM'))) as plan_months from proj_payment where del_flag = '0' group by project_id ) pay_sum on pay_sum.project_id = p.id left join ( select pl.project_id, min(su.nick_name) as nick_name from proj_leader pl left join sys_user su on su.user_id = pl.user_id group by pl.project_id ) leader on leader.project_id = p.id
left join ( select wk.project_id, sum(case when coalesce(pj.project_nature, 'normal') = 'mandate' then 0 else coalesce(wk.external_output, 0) end) as external_output,
sum(coalesce(wk.external_output, 0)) as raw_external_output, sum(coalesce(wk.internal_output, 0)) as internal_output from proj_workload wk join proj_project pj on pj.id = wk.project_id where wk.del_flag = '0' group by wk.project_id ) w_sum on w_sum.project_id = p.id
left join ( select w.project_id, string_agg( cat.name || '：' || trim(to_char(w.workload, 'FM999999990.0')) || coalesce(w.price_unit, ''), chr(10) ) as workload_desc from proj_workload w left join proj_category cat on cat.id = w.category_id where w.del_flag = '0' and w.billing_type = 'external' group by w.project_id ) w_desc on w_desc.project_id = p.id left join proj_category cat on cat.id = p.project_category_id

mapper.select:
select p.id, p.project_code as "projectCode", p.project_name as "projectName", p.engineering_project as "engineeringProject", p.project_category_id as "projectCategoryId", p.client_unit as "clientUnit", p.contact_name as "contactName", p.contact_phone as "contactPhone", p.project_location as "projectLocation", p.contract_id as "contractId", p.status as "projectStatus",
p.project_nature as "projectNature", p.extra_data::text as "projectExtraData", p.assign_date as "assignDate", p.duration_require as "durationRequire", p.total_duration||'工作日' as "totalDuration", p.create_time as "createTime", p.close_time as "closeTime",
pay_sum.plan_months as "planReportTime", p.remark as "remark", p.related_project_id as "relatedProjectId",
coalesce(rp.project_code, p.related_project_code_text) as "relatedProjectCode", sl.submit_time as "submitTime", sl2.submit_time as "relatedLastSubmitTime",
case when then 'submitted' else 'unsubmitted' end as "submitStatus", c.contract_no as "contractNo", c.contract_name as "contractName", c.contract_amount as "contractAmount", c.contract_type as "contractType", (select count(*) from proj_project px where px.contract_id = c.id and px.del_flag = '0') as "contractProjectCount", c.sign_date as "signDate", c.entrust_date as "entrustDate", c.archive_date as "archiveDate", c.contract_period as "contractPeriod", c.payment_terms as "paymentTerms", c.is_settled as "isSettled", c.extra_data::text as "contractExtraData", coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) as "receivedAmount", coalesce(pay_sum.refund_amount, 0) as "refundAmount", pay_sum.max_pay_time as "lastPayTime",
pay_sum.pay_remark as "paymentRemark",
pay_sum.final_pay_time as "finalPayTime", pay_sum.advance_pay_time as "advancePayTime",
pay_sum.advance_amount as "advanceAmount", pay_sum.final_amount as "finalAmount", coalesce(pay_sum.total_invoice, 0) as "totalInvoiceAmount", coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) as "projectSettleAmount",
coalesce(w_sum.raw_external_output, 0) as "projectRawExternalOutput", coalesce(w_sum.internal_output, 0) as "projectInternalOutput", w_desc.workload_desc as "workloadDesc", greatest(coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) - coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0), 0) as "projectArrearsAmount", case when coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0) > 0 then greatest(coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0) - coalesce(w_sum.external_output, 0), 0) else 0 end as "projectOverpaidAmount", leader.nick_name as "leaderName", cat.name as "categoryName", cat.parent_id as "categoryParentId" from proj_project p
where p.del_flag = '0'
-- 报表统一按委托单位排序（空值置后），同单位内保持新项目在前 order by p.client_unit nulls last, p.id desc
limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from proj_project p
where p.del_flag = '0'

select coalesce(p.client_unit, '') as "unit", sum(coalesce(pay_sum.total_received, 0)) as "amount", max(pay_sum.max_pay_time) as "payTime" from proj_project p
where p.del_flag = '0'
group by coalesce(p.client_unit, '')
